title: Arthur742Ramos/finite-graph-fundamental-group
summary: Formalizes the fundamental group of a finite connected graph, represented as a finite weakly connected directed multigraph with its standard interval-cell quotient realization. The main result identifies the topological fundamental group at a chosen vertex with `FreeGroup (Fin (E + 1 - V))`. The proof compares the topological group with the endomorphism group at the root in Mathlib's free groupoid, whose explicit spanning-tree basis supplies the non-tree-edge generators. review.reason: Lean formalization of the fundamental group of finite graphs and its cycle-rank results.
